title: Honey Garlic Chicken
ingredients: Sauce: 8 minced garlic cloves; 2 tbsp butter; 2 tbsp soy sauce; 3 tbsp honey; 1 tbsp rice vinegar
Parsley and green onion to finish
steps: Flatten the chicken to an even thickness. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, oyster sauce and ginger.
Lightly coat both sides with cornstarch. Pan-fry in oil until crisp and the center reaches 165°F.
Melt butter and briefly cook garlic. Stir in soy sauce, honey and vinegar; simmer until slightly thickened.
Return chicken to the pan and coat with sauce. Finish with parsley and green onion.

title: Honey Soy Chicken
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp honey; 3 tbsp soy sauce; 1 1/2 tbsp water; 3 minced garlic cloves; 1 tbsp grated ginger
steps: Pat chicken dry, even out thick portions, season lightly and coat with cornstarch. Rest 3–5 minutes.
Pan-fry in neutral oil for about 4–5 minutes per side. Set chicken aside.
Mix sauce ingredients. Simmer the sauce briefly in the pan, then return chicken and toss until glazed and fully cooked.
Serve with rice.

title: Spicy Steamed Chicken
ingredients: Red chilli, chopped (as much as you like)
steps: In a pot, add water along with ginger, scallions, cloves, peppercorns, and salt. Bring it to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken breasts and gently poach for about 10 minutes. Avoid aggressively boiling the chicken — this keeps it soft and juicy.
Check if the chicken is cooked by poking it with a chopstick or toothpick. If the juices run clear, it’s done.
Shred the chicken into chunky pieces or thin threads — however you like it.
For the sauce, combine chopped spring onions, ginger-garlic paste, and red chilli in a bowl. Pour hot oil over it to make everything fragrant.
Add soy sauce, chili oil, oyster sauce, sesame seeds, and a little of the reserved chicken stock to bring the sauce together.
Pour the sauce all over the shredded chicken and serve immediately.

title: Blackened Salmon
steps: Combine all seasonings.
Coat salmon generously with the spice mixture.
Heat butter in a skillet.
Cook salmon for 4–5 minutes per side until dark and crusty outside.

title: Bourbon Chicken
ingredients: 1 tbsp of cornstarch dissolved in water
steps: Whisk soy sauce, hoisin, ketchup, apple juice, water, vinegar, brown sugar, ginger and garlic.
Season the chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, paprika and pepper. Brown both sides in a little oil.
Remove chicken. Simmer the sauce in the pan until reduced by half, then stir in the cornstarch slurry.
Return the chicken and simmer until fully cooked.

title: Garlic Butter Salmon
steps: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Melt butter and sauté garlic briefly.
Add salmon and cook for 4–5 minutes per side.
Spoon garlic butter over the salmon.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

title: Garlic Butter Parmesan Chicken And Potatoes
ingredients: Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper
Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin
2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt
1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled
steps: In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight).
Preheat your oven to 375°F. Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly.
Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.
Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish.
Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.
Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven.
In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix.
Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy!

title: Honey Glazed Salmon
steps: Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, and lemon juice.
Sear salmon in olive oil.
Pour in the honey mixture.
Cook until the salmon is done and the glaze thickens.
Spoon extra glaze over each fillet.

title: Lemon Herb Salmon
steps: Combine olive oil, lemon, garlic, and herbs.
Brush over the salmon.
Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.
Serve with fresh lemon slices.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
steps: Clean the chicken breast and marinate well with salt, pepper powder, lemon juice along with ginger garlic paste, oregano, chili flakes, oil and pinch of sugar
let this marinated chicken rest in fridge for about 5-6 hours or overnight for more flavour absorption
In a pan brush some oil and add the marinade chicken breast
Cook the chicken well on both sidew until nice juicy, tender inside and crispy brown on the outside
For the dip whisk together greek yogurt along with salt, pepper, lime juice grated galric and chopped coriander
Serve the pan fried chicken along with prepared yohurt dip and enjoy

title: Maple Mustard Salmon
steps: Mix maple syrup, mustard, soy sauce, and garlic.
Brush generously over salmon.
Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.
Brush with extra glaze before serving.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger.
Marinate salmon for 15–20 minutes.
Pan-sear over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side.
Add remaining sauce and simmer until glossy.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

title: Chicken Au Poivre
ingredients: 1 whole young chicken (4–5 lb), spatchcocked, cleaned and pat dry
drizzle of good quality olive oil
1½ cups heavy cream (I used lactose free)
2 tbsp crushed black peppercorns (more or less, and you can ground the texture as coarse or as fine as you like. This is entirely based on preference since they add a kick)
(optional, yes you can sub with a bouillon cube or seasoning)
steps: Pat the chicken dry, rub with olive oil and salt, then roast at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Gently simmer the cream with rosemary, garlic, shallot, peppercorns, salt and the optional seasoning cube.
Pour the cream sauce over the chicken, add a splash of sherry, then roast at 400°F until golden and the chicken reaches 165°F.

title: 1 Pot Chicken Hainan Rice
ingredients: Sauce: 1 tbsp grated ginger; 2 tbsp chopped scallion; 1 1/2 tbsp neutral oil
Sweet soy: 1 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce; 1 tbsp sugar
steps: Season the thighs with salt, white pepper and sesame oil; rest for 10 minutes.
Sauté garlic and ginger in the oil, then briefly stir in the rinsed rice.
Add stock, turmeric and scallion. Set chicken over the rice, bring to a boil, cover and simmer about 15 minutes. Rest off heat for 5–10 minutes; confirm the chicken is cooked.
Pour hot oil over grated ginger and chopped scallion for the first sauce. Warm soy sauce with sugar for the second.
Slice chicken and serve with rice and both sauces.

title: Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo
ingredients: 1.0 lb (8 servings) Banza Fettuccine or Regular Fettuccine
13.5 fl oz (1¾ Cup) Fat Free Evaporated Milk
6.2 oz (¾ Cup) Fat Free Cream Cheese
7.9 oz (1 Cup) Plain Non-Fat Greek Yogurt
3.5 oz (1 Medium) White Onion, Finely Diced
👉 Everything that is optional is NOT included in da macros
steps: Cook fettuccine according to package instructions.
Season chicken with chicken seasoning and coat well.
Sear chicken in a large skillet with olive oil on medium-high heat until deeply golden on all sides, about 10-12 minutes. Set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté onion until caramelised. Add garlic and cook until fragrant. Add seasoning.
Add evaporated milk and fat free cream cheese, stirring until smooth. Mix in Greek yogurt.
Stir in Parmesan until melted. Add pasta water gradually until sauce is thick and glossy.
Toss hot pasta into sauce until every strand is coated.
Divide into 8 portions, top with chicken, finish with optional toppings. Then enjoy!

title: Chicken Gnocchi
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves, minced (or 1 tbsp jarred garlic)
1 cup low-fat plain Greek yogurt (room temperature)
3.5 oz reduced-fat mozzarella or parmesan, shredded
⅓ cup fresh parsley or basil, chopped
steps: Add chicken broth, 1 cup red pesto, garlic, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the crockpot.
Stir, then add the chicken thighs and coat in the sauce
Cook on LOW for 6 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours
Remove the chicken, shred, then return it to the crockpot
Stir in the uncooked gnocchi and spinach. Cook on HIGH for 20–25 minutes until the gnocchi are tender
Whisk together the Greek yogurt, cheese, Fairlife milk, and remaining 2 tbsp red pesto. Slowly whisk in a few spoonfuls of hot crockpot liquid to temper the sauce
Pour the cream sauce into the crockpot and gently stir until everything is coated. Add a splash of broth if needed to thin the sauce
Divide evenly into 8 meal prep containers, then top with green onions and parsley or basil

title: Chicken Pizza Pocket High Protein
ingredients: ½ tsp avocado oil or a few sprays of cooking oil
steps: Preheat your oven to 400°°Fand line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Spread the chicken mince into a thin oval and season.
Add the passata and mozzarella to one half, leaving a little space around the edges.
Use the parchment paper to fold the other half over, then press the edges together to seal.
Sprinkle the Parmigiano Reggiano over the top and gently press it into the chicken.
Give it a quick spray of oil and bake for around 20 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°°Finternally.
Transfer it onto a bare baking tray and grill/broil for a few minutes until golden and crispy 🔥

title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 1.3 lb Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes
1.3 lb Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes
steps: Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated.
In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy.
Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 392°F until crispy.
While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy.
Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY!

title: Lasagna
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery and garlic in a lightly oiled pan; brown the beef.
Add passata, beef stock and lentils. Season and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Layer the beef mixture with lasagna sheets and blended cottage cheese. Sprinkle mozzarella on top.
Bake at 356°F for about 45 minutes, until the pasta is tender.

title: Protein Chicken Pizza
steps: Add the eggs, chicken mince, flour, salt and pizza seasoning to a pan and mix everything together.
Spread it evenly across the pan, cover and cook over medium heat for around 10 minutes, or until the base is golden and cooked enough to flip.
Carefully flip the whole thing over.
Spread over 2.8 oz pizza sauce and top with 1.8 oz mozzarella.
Cover again and cook on low until the cheese is melted and the chicken is completely cooked through.
Slice and enjoy! 🍕

title: Gochujang Chicken
ingredients: 1.8 oz of your chosen Frozen Vegetables (optional)
steps: After washing your rice in the rice cooker bowl - add Bone Broth and Garlic
Marinate Chicken with Sesame oil, Soy sauce, Gochujang and Honey
Add optional Frozen Veggies, then stir well.
Place chicken thigh on top, make sure to add in excess marinate.
Start the rice cooker as normal, enjoy when ready. 🤩

title: Korean Bbq Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 3.5 lb Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat
Dash of Milk for desired consistency
steps: Trim excess fat from chicken thighs, add seasonings and marinade ingredients then mix and set aside
In a bowl, add cucumber, carrots, red onion, sesame seeds, rice vinegar and sriracha. Mix until well combined
In a second bowl, add yogurt, light mayo, gochujang, honey, garlic powder and milk for desired consistency
In a lined large sheet pan, spread marinated chicken evenly. Add cooking spray, oven bake 25-30 mins at 400°Funtil golden!
Toast wraps on a stove flame, slice up chicken then serve with cucumber slaw and gochujang sauce. ENJOY!

title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: Seasoning: 2 tsp chili powder; 1 tsp cumin; 1 tsp paprika; 1/2 tsp each coriander, onion powder, salt and pepper
Tortillas, lime, cilantro and avocado to serve
steps: Heat oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet.
Toss sliced chicken, peppers, onion and garlic with olive oil and all seasonings. Spread in one layer.
Roast 15–20 minutes, turning midway, until chicken is cooked and vegetables soften. Warm tortillas during the final 5 minutes.
Serve with lime, cilantro and avocado.

title: Chipotle Barbacoa
ingredients: 1/2 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
steps: Cubethe chuck roast into even pieces. Get your pan hot with oil, then sear every side until you’ve got a deep, dark crust (tons of flavor).
Toss the chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, oregano, cumin, salt, pepper, garlic, oil, and water into a blender. Blend until it’s silky smooth.
Seared beef goes into the slow cooker first, sauce poured on top, bay leaves last.
Low and slow for 3-4 hours, until the meat shreds apart with ease 🤤

title: Chipotle Honey Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in Chipotle Adobo Sauce with seasonings
Cook the chicken skin side down for 5 minutes each side. Season with salt while cooking.
1 cup washed jasmine rice on the stovetop. Add 2 cups of water and drizzle of oil. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until water is fully absorbed and rice is tender.
Finish the rice with a drizzle of oil then mix in 0.3 cups fresh cilantro, chopped, 0.5 teaspoons salt, and 1 lime, juiced.
Cut the chicken, marinate it with honey adobo sauce, and serve over the cilantro lime rice.

title: Chicken Shawarma
ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into pieces
2 tbsp oil (for marinating) + more for cooking the chicken
1 tbsp red pepper paste or tomato paste
steps: Marinade the chicken: In a bowl, combine chicken with salt, black pepper, red chili powder, smoked, paprika, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, turmeric, onion powder.
Add lemon juice, Toom garlic dip, red pepper paste, tomato paste, oil.  Mix well until the chicken is fully coated. Cover and marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
For the glaze: Mix oil, red pepper paste, sumac, salt, and pomegranate molasses in a small bowl. Set aside.
For Sumac Onions: Combine sliced onion, lemon juice, sumac, parsley, salt, and oil. Toss well and set aside.
Heat oil in skillet over medium high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook in batches for about 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and slightly charred.
Assemble the Shawarma: Take the pita wrap. Spread Toom garlic sauce, add chicken, fries, sumac onions, fries and diced tomatoes.
Roll the pita tightly into a wrap. Toast it in a skillet for 1–2 minutes on each side. Then, coat the wrap with shawarma glaze and cook until it’s golden and crispy.
Serve warm with more Toom garlic sauce and fries.

title: Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 10.6 oz Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand)
4.2 oz Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee)
steps: Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate.

Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden.
In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 400°Ffor 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy.
While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth.
Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. ENJOY!

title: Koobideh Kebabs
ingredients: ¼ cup parsley, finely blended (not traditional)
3½ cups cooked jasmine rice total (½ cup per serving)
Turmeric works too for that iconic golden color
steps: Add the onion and parsley to a blender and blend until finely minced.
Mix with the ground beef, tomato paste, and seasonings until fully combined.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spread the meat mixture evenly across the pan.
Use a knife or spatula to create grooves, and split the kabobs.
spray with oil.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Finish under the broiler on HIGH for 2 minutes.

title: Massaman Lamb Curry
ingredients: 2.2 lb lean lamb leg (divide into 4 pieces - use lean chuck or even skinless thigh)
2.1 oz Massaman curry paste (Maesri or similar)
1.3 lb cocktail potatoes (halved if using chicken thigh)
steps: Preheat oven to 356°F (320°F fan).
Whisk the curry paste, coconut milk and stock together in a baking dish/oven safe pot. Onion, potato, star anise, cinnamon and raw lamb in → turn everything to coat. That’s it.
Cover with foil → bake 2-3 hours.
Uncover → bake a further 15 minutes at 230, until the lamb is charred and the sauce has reduced a little.
Skim any surface fat before serving — tilt the dish, it lifts off easily.
Chilli and coriander over the top.

title: Satay Chicken
ingredients: 1.1 lb skinless chicken thigh, (cut into 1.0 in pieces)
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, curry paste, curry powder, honey and salt together → chicken in, coat well.
Marinate 2 hours minimum, overnight is better.
Whisk the PB2 into the hot water until smooth → coconut milk, curry paste, dark soy, lime → taste, adjust to your liking.
Thread 8 skewers, roughly 2.1 oz chicken each.

Grill, barbecue, or oven at 428°F top shelf → 3–4 minutes a side, until charred and cooked through. Pan works too — oil spray in a hot skillet, same timing (I recommend oven since the marinade can stick to pan)
Rest 2 minutes → crushed peanuts over the sauce → coriander, chilli and lime wedges on the plate → serve alongside.
For the rice bowl do 4 skewers and 5.3 oz cooked rice + some of the sauce

title: Ginger Scallion Chicken
steps: Place an inverted small bowl inside a larger bowl and arrange the chicken over it. Add ginger, scallions and red chilli.
Place the bowl in a water bath, cover and steam for 15–20 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely chop ginger, scallions and coriander and mix with chilli oil.
Remove the chicken, then carefully take out the inverted bowl and save those juices — that's the liquid gold. Shred the chicken into strips.
Add 100Mls of hot water and mix it with half a cube of stock and mix it well in the broth.
Mix the flavour bomb with salt, white pepper, soy sauce and oyster sauce. Add the shredded chicken and finish with the hot broth.
Serve over hot rice and enjoy! 🍗🔥

title: Miso Brothy Chicken
ingredients: Broth: 16 fl oz chicken stock; 4 garlic cloves; 1/4 in ginger; 2 tbsp lemon juice; 2 tbsp orange juice; 1 tbsp miso; 1 tbsp soy sauce; 2 tsp fish sauce
Herb salad: 1 green onion; parsley; cilantro; 1/2 lemon; 1 tsp sesame oil; chili oil
steps: Marinate the chicken for 30 minutes in miso, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil and garlic.
Sear the chicken in a skillet until cooked through.
Sauté ginger and garlic; add the remaining broth ingredients and heat until the miso dissolves.
Mix the chopped herbs, green onion, lemon and sesame oil. Serve chicken and broth over rice with the herb salad and chili oil.

title: Greek Chicken Lemon Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp. Black Pepper + more as needed
steps: heat up olive oil. Add onions. Sauté until translucent. Add the carrots and celery. Cook until softened. (5-7 mins).
Add garlic cook until fragrant.
Add the seasonings.
Add chicken breast and 2 bay leaves. Add broth. Re-season with s + p. Bring to a boil then simmer for 15 mins. until chicken is cooked through. Remove chicken and bay leaves from the pot.
Add uncooked rice to the pot. While that’s cooking, shred the chicken.
Once the rice is cooked add the shredded chicken back in. Turn the heat down to a simmer.
In a separate bowl whisk 2 eggs together. Add freshly squeezed lemon juice and whisk together until smooth.

Slowly add one ladle of the hot soup, (making sure the soup is not boiling), into the egg mixture, whisking continuously to temper the eggs. Add another ladle. Whisk until the egg mixture is warm to the touch. Slowly add the tempered mixture into the pot, stirring as you pour it.
Finish with chopped dill, lemon zest and black pepper.

title: Carnivore Bread
ingredients: 4.2 oz Flavourless Whey Protein (use code MOORE @ legion)
1.1 oz Flavourless Collagen (use code MOORE @ legion)
3.2 oz Plain Low Fat Greek Yogurt
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and egg yolk until the mixture is smooth and not gluey. Add the Greek yogurt and mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, combine protein, collagen, salt, and baking soda. Mix well.
Add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture all at once.
Stir gently at first, then mix more vigorously until the batter is smooth and evenly combined.
Line tray it with parchment paper (preferably unbleached and chlorine-free). Pour the batter and smooth the top.
Bake at 375°°F for 30 minutes, or until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

title: Healthy French Toast
ingredients: To a bowl add Vanilla Greek yogurt - 14.1 oz
steps: Whisk the yogurt, eggs and cornstarch until smooth.
Air-fry half the batter at 356°F for 25 minutes.
Top with peanut butter and honey, if using.

title: Healthy Tiramisu
ingredients: Oats: 2 ripe bananas; 2 1/2 cups milk; 6 fl oz espresso; 4 tbsp maple syrup; 3 tbsp smooth nut butter; 2 tsp vanilla; 1 tbsp cider vinegar
2 1/2 cups rolled oats; 1 tbsp cocoa; 1/4 cup vanilla protein powder (optional); 1 1/2 tsp baking powder; 1/2 tsp baking soda; 1/8 tsp salt
Topping: 3 cups thick yogurt; 2 tbsp nut butter; 1/2 tsp vanilla; 1/4 cup protein powder (optional); maple syrup to taste; cocoa for dusting
steps: Heat oven to 350°F and grease an 8-inch square baking dish.
Mash bananas; whisk in milk, espresso, syrup, nut butter, vanilla and vinegar. Combine oats, cocoa, protein powder and leaveners separately.
Stir wet and dry mixtures together. Spread in the dish and bake 35–40 minutes. Let cool completely.
Warm topping nut butter briefly, then stir in yogurt, vanilla and optional protein powder. Spread on cooled oats and dust with cocoa.

title: Air Fryer Parmesan Bites
ingredients: Use marinara sauce or any dipping sauce that you like.
steps: Mix together 6oz of finely shredded parmesan cheese with 2.3 oz of egg whites. Don’t use regular eggs here, or it will be “eggy”.
Mix the mixture really well, then divide them into balls. Roll these in about 1 inch balls. You’ll need to pack them nice and tight.
Lay the rolled up balls on a plate or on a sheet pan and freeze for 2 hours
Remove, airfry at 400F for 10 minutes.
Dip it into your favorite sauce (I used marinara!) and enjoy.

title: Buffalo Chicken Mozzarella Stick
steps: Coat the mozzarella sticks with ground chicken. Toss in egg wash & then Parmesan.
Air fry @ 400F for 10-12 mins. Take them out, add your buffalo sauce & enjoy!

title: Crab Rangoon Balls
steps: Combine your crab meat, cream cheese and green onions.
Roll into 4-6 balls and freeze for an hour.
Coat with egg, Parmesan and air fry @ 400F for 6-10 minutes.
Take them out and enjoy!

title: Crispy Onion Rings
ingredients: Optional lighter version: 3.5 oz onion; 3.5 oz Eatlean cheese; salt, pepper, garlic
steps: Spread the cheese out on baking paper
Layer the onion rings over the top
Season generously (get creative here)
Light spray of olive oil
Bake at 392°F for 20-25 minutes
Lift them out and let them cool (this is where they crisp up 👀)

title: Healthy Fries
ingredients: 1 tsp each: Paprika, garlic powder & onion powder
steps: Mix all ingredients well & put them in a ziplock bag.
Cut a tiny hole in the corner and squeeze out little squigglies on a greased, parchment lined sheet.
Bake @ 400F for 20 mins. Take them out and enjoy!

title: Potato Smash
ingredients: ok this is genuinely the easiest snack ever and way better than chips. crispy cheesy potato bites in like 25 min total. 🫠
salt + seasoning: paprika, chili, garlic powder
Dipping sauce: 2 tbsp mayo; 1 tbsp sriracha; 1 tsp mustard; 1 tsp paprika; water; parsley
steps: halve 5 potatoes and boil 10-15 min until fork tender
drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil on a baking tray
sprinkle half the mozzarella in a thin layer
place potatoes cut-side up on the cheese and smash flat with a glass
season with salt and your favorite spices
top with the rest of the mozzarella
bake at 350F (356°F) for 12 min until golden and crispy
Stir the sauce ingredients together and serve with the potato bites.

title: Peri Peri Sauce
steps: Add the sweet peppers, hot peppers, onion, garlic, vinegar, lemon juice, smoked paprika, chili powder, salt, pepper, and oregano to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
With the blender running, slowly drizzle in the olive oil until the sauce becomes creamy and emulsified.
Add the lemon zest and blend for another 10–15 seconds.
🔥 Use this sauce to marinate or baste your peri peri chicken while it cooks for that bold, smoky, tangy flavour.

title: Brownie Recipe
steps: melt the chocolate chips with the yogurt and peanut butter until fully combined – mix well
pour the mixutre onto a lined container
freeze for 1-2 hours
slice into bites & enjoy!

title: Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Spread the cream cheese on the tortilla with the cinnamon and sweetener.
Roll tightly and brush it with your butter. Slice into a few pieces.
Air fry @ 400F for 5-7 mins. Take them out, add icing and enjoy!!

title: Double Chocolate Cheesecake
steps: Heat oven to 325°F and prepare a 9-inch springform pan.
Blend cream cheese, cottage cheese, eggs, sweetener, protein powder, cocoa and salt until smooth.
Pour into the pan. Warm frosting briefly, drizzle it over the batter and swirl.
Bake for 45–50 minutes until the edges set but the center still jiggles.
Cool in the switched-off oven with the door ajar for 15–20 minutes.
Cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 6 hours before slicing.

title: Healthy Brookie 1
ingredients: 1.4 oz (3 tbsp) Plain or Vanilla Nonfat Greek Yogurt
0.8 fl oz (1 tbsp + 2 tsp) Egg Whites
0.35 oz (1 tbsp + 1 tsp) All Purpose Flour
2.8 oz (1/3 Cup) Plain or Vanilla Nonfat Greek Yogurt
1.2 oz (1/4 Cup) All Purpose Flour (you can add more flour to make it denser)
2.5 oz–3.4 oz (6-8 tbsp) Granulated Sugar Substitute
0.71 oz (2/3 Scoop) Whey/Casein Blend Protein Powder
0.88 oz (1/4 Cup) Black or Dark Cocoa Powder
steps: Preheat oven to 350°°Fand lightly spray two 5-or 6-inch springform pans.
Mix the cookie batter wet and dry ingredients separately, then combine.
Mix the brownie batter wet and dry ingredients separately, then combine. Do not overmix.
Divide the brownie batter evenly between both pans.
Dollop the cookie batter over the brownie batter, gently spread, and add choc chips.
Bake 28-38 min (6-inch) or 32-42 min (5-inch), until the edges are set and the centers are slightly soft.
Cool in the pans for 30 minutes be

title: Healthy Brookie 2
ingredients: 1.5 fl oz (3 tbsp) Unsweetened Almond Milk
Extra 0.53 oz (~2 tbsp) All Purpose Flour (optional — double for a denser brownie)
1.3 oz–1.7 oz (3–4 tbsp) Granulated Sugar Substitute
0.25 oz (~1/4 Scoop) Whey/Casein Blend Protein Powder
0.35 oz (~2 tbsp) Black or Dark Cocoa Powder
Extra Ice Cream + Chocolate Sauce on Top is Optional
Casein works best for the cookie batter and a whey/casein blend for the brownie batter.
👉 Everything optional is NOT included in da macros.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix egg whites, pumpkin, and almond milk until smooth.
Mix in remaining brownie ingredients until a thick batter forms.
Pour into a greased or parchment-lined 5 or 6 inch round or square dish/ring. For a standard brownie pan, 2x the recipe.
Mix softened butter, erythritol, brown erythritol, applesauce, egg whites, and vanilla.
Mix in casein, baking powder, and salt until a thick cookie dough forms.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Bake 15–20 min, until the outside is set and a toothpick comes out clean. Add 3 cookie dough dollops on top, then bake 3 more min.
Let cool slightly and add optional chocolate chips + chunks before removing from pan.

title: Healthy Brownies
ingredients: 7.4 oz–8.1 oz (1 to 1⅛ Cups) Granulated 1:1 Sugar Substitute (ie: Lakanto or Swerve) or Regular Sugar
2.1 oz (about 2 Scoop) Chocolate or Vanilla Protein Powder
Chocolate Chips or Chunks to Taste
👉 Everything that is optional is not included in da macros
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a bowl, whisk together all wet ingredients.
Add dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Pour into a 2 small circular springboard pans or one regular brownie tray.
Bake for 20–25 minutes (take out slightly underdone). Then enjoy!

title: Healthy Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: (I added 50 extra chocolate chips and 0.25 tsp of coconut oil for the top layer, that’s optional just for aesthetics)
steps: Beat the eggs until no more clumps
Mix in Greek Yogurt
Pour in melted chocolate slowly, if it clumps up, you can microwave the entire batter for 10-20 seconds so that there’s no chocolate clumps
Fill a large pan with water (preferably hot)
Pour the batter into a separate container and place that container into the large pan so that the water is halfway up
Place into oven and bake at 325F for 45 minutes
Take out, let it cool in the fridge and enjoy!

title: Healthy Peanut Butter Cheesecake
ingredients: 16 oz low-fat cream cheese, room temperature
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and lightly grease a 9-inch springform pan.
Blend cream cheese, Greek yogurt, and sweetener until smooth.
Add powdered peanut butter and vanilla and blend again.
Pulse in the eggs on low just until incorporated.
Pour into the pan and bake for 45 minutes, until the edges are set.
Turn off the oven and let the cheesecake cool inside for 20 minutes with the door closed.
Whisk the sugar-free syrup and powdered peanut butter until smooth.
Spread the glaze over the cooled cheesecake.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours before slicing.

title: High Protein Fudge Cheesecake
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Pour into a lined 6-inch round dish.
Bake at 325°F for 45–50 minutes until set at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Chill for at least 8 hours before slicing.

title: Lemon Olive Oil Honey Cake
ingredients: 1/4 cup honey for whipped honey glaze (optional)
steps: Boil the whole lemon for 25 minutes, then blend with the olive oil, honey and eggs.
Combine with oat flour, baking powder and salt. Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes. Add whipped honey glaze if desired.

title: Oreo Brownie
ingredients: 10.0 oz (1 1/4 Cup) Vanilla, Chocolate, or Plain Nonfat Greek Yogurt
If batter is too thick, you may need to add more almond milk as I did in the video
2.5 oz (1/2 Cup + 2 tbsp) Granulated Sugar Substitute
1.6 oz casein, 0.53 oz whey chocolate protein powder (I used
0.88 oz (1/4 Cup + 1 tbsp) Black or Dark Cocoa Powder
2.4 oz (1/4 Cup + 1 tbsp) Nonfat Greek Yogurt
1 Scoop Whey/Casein Blend Protein Powder (*optional - adds frosting thickness, I use half choc, half vanilla protein)
1 Oreo Balanced on Top for Decoration
👉 Everything that is optional is NOT included in da macros
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix wet ingredients in one bowl and dry ingredients in another.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until smooth with no clumps.
Pour batter into a sprayed or parchment-lined loaf tin.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, slightly underbaking for a softer texture.
While baking, mix frosting ingredients and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Frost brownies, add toppings, and chill 10+ more minutes if desired.
Slice into 2 brownie bricks or 8 slices and enjoy.

title: Pistachio Cheesecake
steps: Heat oven to 325°F and line a 6-inch round pan.
Blend all ingredients except topping until perfectly smooth. Pour into the pan.
Bake 40–45 minutes until the edges set and the center still moves slightly.
Cool, then refrigerate at least 8 hours. Add crushed pistachios before serving.

title: Creamy Cajun Steak & Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Season and sear the steak in olive oil until cooked as desired. Finish with butter, garlic, and parsley.
Coat potatoes and vegetables with seasonings, Parmesan, and oil. Bake or air-fry at 360°F for 20–24 minutes until tender.
Melt sauce butter with seasonings; whisk in milk and cream cheese, then Parmesan.
Serve steak over the potatoes and vegetables with the Cajun sauce.
ingredients: Steak: 2.2 lb top sirloin/topside beef, cubed
1 1/2 tsp each garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, and parsley
1/2 tsp each salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian herbs, and parsley

title: Mexican Street Corn Chicken
steps: Coat chicken with the seasonings, olive oil, and lime juice.
Cook chicken thoroughly, rest briefly, and slice.
Season corn, onion, pepper, and jalapeño. Roast at 390°F for about 15 minutes; cool slightly and mix with yogurt, mayo, feta, cilantro, and Tajín.
Cook rice and fold in cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Serve the chicken with street corn and cilantro-lime rice.
ingredients: Street corn: 3 1/2 cups canned sweet corn

title: Middle Eastern Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowls
steps: Coat chicken in its marinade ingredients and let stand if time allows.
Bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes and broil about 5 minutes; rest and slice.
Cook rice. Sauté onion in butter with the rice seasonings, then fold into rice.
Combine parsley, tomatoes, green onion, oil, lemon, salt, sumac, and chili flakes.
Whisk the sauce ingredients and assemble bowls with rice, chicken, tabouleh, and sauce.
ingredients: Golden herb rice: 1 3/4 cups uncooked basmati

title: Alfredo Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Season chicken and cook in olive oil until browned and fully cooked; slice.
Sauté garlic and white onion in butter. Add milk and whisk in cream cheese and Parmesan; season.
Cook rice. Roast red onion and sun-dried tomatoes with seasoning at 400°F for about 15 minutes.
Fold the roasted vegetables and parsley into the rice.
Serve chicken over the Tuscan rice with Alfredo sauce.
ingredients: at least 1 3/4 cups skim or evaporated milk (upper end of range unclear in PDF)
Tuscan rice: 1 3/4 cups uncooked white basmati rice

title: Chipotle Steak Bowl
steps: Season steak and marinate overnight if possible.
Cook about 4 minutes per side over medium heat, adjusting for doneness; rest and slice.
Blend or mash avocado with yogurt, cilantro, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Mix tomato, onion, peppers, cilantro, seasoning, and lime for pico.
Build bowls with rice, lettuce, beans, corn, steak, pico, and avocado sauce. Keep cold components separate for meal prep.
ingredients: Steak: 1 3/4 lb lean topside beef steaks
Sides: about 5 oz cooked cilantro-lime rice per serving

title: Chicken Tacos
steps: Season and cook chicken until done, then slice.
Sauté peppers and onion with reserved seasonings; simmer with tomatoes and water until tender.
Warm tortillas and fill with chicken, vegetables, and mozzarella.
Fold and toast in a lightly greased pan for 1–2 minutes per side.
Finish with cilantro and lime.
ingredients: Chicken: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, halved horizontally
Veggies: 1/2 red and 1/2 green bell pepper
about 2 1/4 oz cooked chicken per taco
about 1/3 oz shredded mozzarella per taco

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Wraps
steps: Marinate chicken with garlic, oregano, paprika, seasoning, and lemon for at least 30 minutes.
Skewer or pack the chicken tightly; bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes or air-fry at 400°F for about 18 minutes until cooked through.
Mix mayo, Sriracha, seasonings, and lemon juice.
Warm flatbreads; add lettuce, onion, tomato, and chicken.
Drizzle sauce and wrap. A little melted light butter on the chicken is optional.
ingredients: 3 garlic cloves or 1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, and paprika

steps: Coat chicken in both soy sauces, pepper, garlic powder, and cornstarch.
Air-fry chicken at 400°F for 10–12 minutes, turning as needed, or cook in a hot skillet until crisp and fully cooked.
Season potato fries and bake at 410°F for about 25 minutes or air-fry at 410°F for 12–15 minutes.
Sauté onion and peppers with seasonings and chili flakes.
Toss chicken and chips with vegetables; finish with green onion.

title: Halal Cart Chicken & Rice
steps: Season chicken with spices, oil, and lemon juice.
Cook over high heat about 3–4 minutes per side until browned and fully cooked.
Cook basmati with turmeric, cumin, paprika, garlic, and salt; fluff.
Stir together the garlic sauce ingredients.
Divide rice into four portions; top with chicken, lettuce, tomato, cilantro, and sauce. Keep cold components separate for meal prep.
ingredients: Garlic sauce: 2/3 cup fat-free Greek yogurt
Golden rice: about 1 cup uncooked basmati rice (PDF says about 4 cups cooked)

title: Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Season and air-fry potatoes at 400°F for 18–20 minutes, or bake at 400°F for 20–23 minutes.
Season chicken and cook in olive oil until fully cooked.
Reduce heat and stir in milk, cream cheese, Parmesan, and extra seasonings until smooth.
Fold cooked potatoes into the sauce.
Top with mozzarella, cover 4–5 minutes to melt, and finish with parsley.

title: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with garlic, paprika, pepper, Sriracha, soy sauce, and oil for 1–2 hours.
Cook chicken about 3–4 minutes per side until browned and fully cooked.
Turn heat off, add honey, and toss until coated.
Cook garlic for 1–2 minutes, then soften onion and bell pepper.
Stir in cooked rice, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil; fold in chicken and top with green onion and sesame.
ingredients: 4 minced garlic cloves or 1 tbsp garlic powder
2 tbsp soy sauce (half light, half dark)

title: Chicken Shawarma & Fries
steps: Marinate chicken with garlic, spices, oil, tomato paste, and lemon, ideally overnight.
Pack into a baking dish and bake until cooked through; cool slightly and slice.
Season and bake fries at 400°F for about 25 minutes or air-fry about 15 minutes.
Whisk sauce ingredients.
Combine slaw ingredients and serve with chicken, fries, and sauce.
ingredients: Chicken: 2 lb thinly sliced chicken breast
Garlic sauce: 3/4 cup low-fat Greek yogurt

steps: Season chicken with spices, lime juice, and oil.
Sauté onion and pepper; add rice and seasoning and toast for 1–2 minutes.
Add water or stock; cover and simmer on low for 12–15 minutes, stirring halfway.
Cook chicken separately until fully cooked and browned.
Fold beans and cilantro into rice, add chicken, and divide into four portions.

title: Creamy Steak Fajita Pasta
steps: Cook pasta until al dente and reserve 1/3 cup cooking water.
Season and sear steak in olive oil and butter to desired doneness; rest.
Sauté onions and peppers until softened and lightly charred.
On low heat, stir milk, cream cheese, Parmesan, seasonings, and reserved pasta water into a smooth sauce.
Simmer pasta and vegetables in sauce until thickened; serve sliced steak over top with parsley.
ingredients: Steak: 1 1/2 lb lean topside beef steaks
Pasta: 8 1/2 oz uncooked penne (about 19 oz cooked)

title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
steps: Cut steak into 1-inch cubes and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and parsley.
Air-fry seasoned potatoes at 400°F until tender and golden; oil is optional.
Toss steak in olive oil and air-fry at 400°F for 12–15 minutes, shaking as needed.
Melt butter with garlic in a pan; toss in steak and finish with more butter and parsley.
Mix mayo, Sriracha, and lemon juice; serve with steak and potatoes.
ingredients: Steak: 1 3/4 lb lean topside beef, 1-inch cubes
1 1/2 tbsp light butter for cooking + 1 1/2 tbsp to finish
